definitions.short: properly, to penetrate ; hence, to examine intimately
definitions.usage: find out, (make) search (out), seek (out), sound, try.
definitions.full: H2713. chaqar [ חָקַר ] verb search (Late Hebrew id. , Niph`al passive, Aramaic חֲקַר ) — Qal Perfect 3masculine singular suffix וַחֲקָרוֺ consecutive Prov 18:17 ; חֲקָרָהּ Job 28:27 ; וְחָֽקַרְתָּ֫ Deut 13:15 etc.; Imperfect יַחְקֹר Job 13:19 ; יַחֲקָרֿ Psa 44:22 ; יַחְקְרֶנּוּ Prov 28:11 ; אֶחְקֹר 1Sam 20:12 ; תַּחְקְרוּן Job 32:11 ; נַחְקֹ֑רָה Lam 3:40 etc.; Imperative חָקְרֵ֫נִי Psa 139:23 ; חִקְרוּ Judg 18:2 ; Infinitive חֲקֹר 2Sam 10:3 2 t.; לַחְקוֺר Prov 23:30 ; לְחָקְרָהּ Judg 18:2 ; — 1 search (for) , followed by accusative Prov 23:30 ; Job 32:11 ; absolute הֵיטֵיב וְשָׁאַלְתָּ֫ וְחָקַרְתָּ֫ וְדָרַשְׁתָּ֫ Deut 13:15 ; literal Ezek 39:14 (i.e. for bones unburied). 2. a. search through, explore , literally, object הארץ Judg 18:2 (|| רַגֵּל ) 18:2 , 1Chr 19:3 (|| id. ); city העיר 2Sam 10:3 (|| id. ), of mining Job 28:3 ; search out a subject or matter 5:27 ; 28:27 ; Prov 25:2 ; Psa 44:22 . b. search a man, find out his sentiments (AV sound him) 1Sam 20:12 . c. of ׳י searching man, with accusative Psa 139:1 (|| ידע ), 139:23 (|| id. ) Job 13:9 , compare Jer 17:10 (object לֵב ). d. of examining thoroughly , so as to expose weakness in a case Job 29:16 ; Prov 18:17 , compare 28:11 ; so of self-examination ׳ח דרכים Lam 3:40 (|| חפשׂ ). Niph`al Perfect נֶחְקַר 1Kin 7:47 ; 2Chr 4:18 ; Imperfect יֵחָקֵר Jer 46:23 ; יֵחָֽקְרוּ 31:37 be searched out, found out, ascertained , 1Kin 7:47 ; 2Chr 4:18 (weight of the bronze used in temple utensils), of forest Jer 46:23 ; searched out , 31:37 subject ארץ מוסדיֿ Pi`el Perfect חִקֵּר Eccl 12:9 he sought out many proverbs ( מְשָׁלִים ; || אִזֵּן ).
